name: codex-profile-agents-disabled
goal: Enforce disabled nested agents in native Codex task profiles.

evidence: The official Codex client exposed collaboration with features.multi_agent=false. With agents.enabled=false and both multi-agent flags disabled its reported tool inventory excluded collaboration.
The existing prepare method cases asserted features.multi_agent=false but did not assert the client agent enablement or v2 override. Strengthen those cases without adding titles.
At b853f8a69f both existing prepare cases failed because their authored agent-disable expectations were false; the unchanged failing run is recorded.
Commit 1f1e95bab5 explicitly disables agents.enabled and features.multi_agent_v2 alongside the existing multi-agent flag.
The unchanged four-case matrix passed at 1f1e95bab5 using the recorded red command and the same sanitized environment profile.
